summary: Great Gosforth location · Three bedrooms · Available April 2024 · Off-street parking
description:
My Property Box are pleased to welcome this spacious three bedroom apartment, situated at the popular Kirkley Lodge development, Gosforth. Convenient location close to Wansbeck Metro Station, local schools and amenities. The apartment offers a generous living accommodation, kitchen with a range of appliances, three bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and family bathroom. Electric heating, entry phone system and pay as you go laundry facilities within the building.

Priced at £650pcm. Unfurnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
